agentsite.title: Actual agent rerouting and live aquarium are next
agentsite.display: The current priority is to detect agents at the edge and actually route them to an agent-facing site, with live chiplet placements and a reproducible package for engineers.
qualifications: An observer-only page does not satisfy the requested routing behavior.
Implementation and deployment were not yet independently verified at the cutoff.

agentsite.title: Agent-site science packet delivered
agentsite.display: Two science content files totaling 14,909 bytes were delivered privately and byte-verified for the agent-facing site work.
qualifications: This is descriptive scientific content, not a memory-system implementation, live route or deployed agent runtime.
A new native6 identity cannot retrospectively validate withdrawn native7 history.

science.title: Informed peer model critique
science.display: The informed peer model (v3) reports coupling-dependent temperature spread and ordering in a simplified model. The lead reviewer verified its report and source and performed static review.
qualifications: This is an informed peer claim, not a blind first report or native reproduction.
The lead reviewer did not execute the model. Offset/rank carry and summed sampled-uncertainty bounds remain unsupported.
Extra rank and curve diagnostics are separate future work.

science.title: Seven retained wire-consistency results
science.display: Seven retained author routing results agree with the paper within 0.1%. The lead reviewer reviewed source, formulation and finite fixtures; it did not run the real optimizer.
qualifications: Agreement supports consistency, not unique absolute coordinates. Extraction and verification reuse panels.
Raw reconstruction and legal half-millimetre variants have separate identities; sampled sensitivity is not a uniform error bound.
At the cutoff, the pre-routing guard and launch-audit correction was still under review.

gate.title: Native gate remains an eight-plus-four proposal
gate.display: The agreed design allocates eight primary combinations across two raw 45 mm references, native6/native7 and grid32/grid64, plus four fresh grid64 replays. No numerical execution release exists.
qualifications: Raw paper-match references and separate snapped engineering layouts keep distinct identities. Deferred references and separate 46-call sensitivity work are not appended.
The latest proposed 600-CPU-second cap sits within an 1800-CPU-second envelope; the 564-second arithmetic is a forecast, not established lifecycle feasibility.
Exact source/build/binary/input/host/supervisor/window/grant admission remains required. One kelvin is prospective engineering reproduction tolerance, not physical accuracy.

gate.title: Scientific acceptance and full runtime remain open
gate.display: Physical TTC validation and the held-out five-arm study remain open, alongside actual scientific agents, eligible data, independent reproduction and full CLI/MCP runtime parity.
qualifications: They remain deliverables; they do not prevent a separately admitted descriptive computational comparison.
Interfaces, fixture results, source approval and green CI do not establish model/provider/payer admission or scientific acceptance.

scope.title: Original scope remains open
scope.display: The original plan still contains 41 tickets, 234 requirements, 104 CLI declarations and 104 MCP declarations. All eight deliverables remain incomplete.
qualifications: Additive research and implementation tickets do not replace the original counts.
Original chiplet simulation and visualization; no silicon-performance or generalization claim.

scope.title: Headroom history remains inconclusive

qualifications: Historical v3 remains INCONCLUSIVE. Raw long-search best lacks fresh reproduction.
A 43.19-CPU-minute proportional forecast is not a proven minimum; retained history is not reset or refunded.
